review_notes: Issue #1701 reproduces an integer concatenation TypeError through synchronous NativeEnvironment rendering, and merged PR #1702 fixes the BlockReference concat path from the recorded pre-fix SHA.
The production scope is only src/jinja2/runtime.py; CHANGES.rst and tests/test_nativetypes.py are excluded, and the synchronous BlockReference.__call__ path is the single pre-fix symbol target.
Issue #1705 provides a missing-template-directory reproduction and traceback; merged PR #1706 adds the specific PackageLoader error at the recorded pre-fix boundary.
The production fix is confined to src/jinja2/loaders.py::PackageLoader.__init__; CHANGES.rst and the loader regression test are excluded.
Issue #724 supplies a minimal async-fixture reproduction whose later asyncio.run call reports an unclosed event loop; merged PR #1430 corrects policy and runner lifecycle handling.
The old _temporary_event_loop_policy call creates and preserves the leaking loop, so it is the single pre-fix symbol target; changelog and Pytester regression files are excluded.
Issue #6643 demonstrates urllib3 reinterpreting a //v:h request target, and merged PR #6644 trims excess leading separators from the exact recorded pre-fix commit.
The production change is confined to src/requests/adapters.py::HTTPAdapter.request_url; the added adapter regression test is excluded.
Issue #9798 provides a concrete setattr false-negative reproduction, and the first commit of merged PR #11159 has the recorded pre-fix SHA as its parent outside the PR commit set.
The production fix is ClassChecker._check_attribute_defined_outside_init; test fixtures, regression data, custom_dict.txt, and whatsnew fragments are excluded.
Merged PR #1949 directly closes Issue #1948 and changes only the production processor plus an excluded integration regression test from the recorded pre-fix SHA.
The fix handles escaped-brace F-string tokens while building logical lines, making FileProcessor.build_logical_line_tokens the reviewed pre-fix symbol target.
Issue #59609 has a concrete UInt64 and NumPy-array precision-loss reproducer, and merged PR #66794 changes pandas/core/algorithms.py::isin from the recorded pre-fix boundary.
PR #66794 also references Issue #61676; only Issue #59609 is retained so one fix is not counted twice, while tests and the v3.1 whatsnew entry are excluded.
Issue #1369 reports CryptographyDeprecationWarning frames in ECDH key exchange, and merged PR #1379 replaces deprecated elliptic-curve APIs in both runtime modules from the recorded pre-fix SHA.
setup.py remains ground truth because the cryptography minimum-version change is required by the new APIs; .travis.yml and tests/test_kex.py are excluded.
Issue #4945 provides a URL credential decoding reproduction, and merged PR #5055 adds the decoding behavior inside the existing Url class from the recorded pre-fix SHA.
The automatic three-file set is narrowed to src/urllib3/util/url.py: request.py is documentation-only and socks.py is auxiliary reuse from another fix, not Issue #4945 ground truth.
Issue #21122 reproduces CycloneDX exports omitting distribution hashes already present in uv.lock, and merged PR #21131 implements the hash conversion and CLI plumbing from the recorded pre-fix SHA.
Both Rust production files are required while the export snapshot test is excluded; symbol ground truth remains empty because the current index does not extract Rust symbols.

rejections.reason: PR #66794 is already represented by the overlapping Issue #59609 case; accepting Issue #61676 would count the same fix twice.
